clues.text: In the early Jerusalem church, this woman and her husband sold a piece of property.
This wife fully knew that her husband kept back part of the land money he brought to the apostles.
About three hours after her husband died, this woman came in, not knowing what had happened.
Peter asked this woman if their land had sold for a certain price, and she said yes.
Peter asked this wife how she and her husband could agree to test the Spirit of the Lord.
Peter told this woman that the feet of the men who buried her husband were at the door.
In Jerusalem, young men found this woman dead at Peter's feet and buried her beside her husband.
